highlights: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Designed an admin dashboard for managing bookings, users, and travel packages, streamlining day-to-day operations for the internal team.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system for a restaurant client, replacing manual order tracking with a live digital workflow.
Built the frontend in Angular with a C# and MS SQL Server backend, ensuring reliable, low-latency transaction handling for daily operations.
Designed the UI/UX in Figma and deployed the system on Azure, delivering an end-to-end solution used in a live business setting.
